Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Round Glass and Gold Coffee Table, 36"W, Gold Finish
Colors: Gold
Materials: glass
This beautiful, modern round table will add a touch of glam to your living room. Tempered glass is accented by a sleek gold-finished frame. This durable table will be a convenient place to set mugs, remote controls and magazines for years to come. 36"Diameter x 18.5"H Sleek modern frame with gold finish; tempered glass A modern table with touches of glam Tempered glass and metal frame are durable and easy to clean Assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
